title: Optional XTP capability binding without transport lock-in
summary: Queue Fabric supports TCP/TLS and other approved sockets. With XTP it may use named services, priority, multipath, rate pacing and multicast only after explicit capability negotiation.
invariants: ConnectSelector and SocketSelector are existing boundaries, not replaced by an XTP-only selector.
Named service addresses resolve logical peers, not user-controlled IP endpoints.
No unauthenticated downgrade, NOERR substitution or new queue-object serialization.
XTP owns L2 0x817D, L3 raw36 and qualified L4 UDP routes; Queue Fabric preserves durable identity.
